summary: ISQ Open Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of its equity securities (Series I and II) to investors and independent directors for cash or services, totaling $16,650,133, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. The filing also announces an asset acquisition of the Saragon AI colocation data center platform and provides monthly Transactional Net Asset Value per share as of July 31, 2026, ranging from $24.78 to $33.89 per class. This is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing fundraising, NAV updates, and portfolio activity, not a special-situation corporate event.
